nl_prompt: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary? postgres: SELECT "disp"."account_id", (SELECT MAX("A11") - MIN("A11") FROM "district") as gap FROM "disp" INNER JOIN "client" ON "disp"."client_id" = "client"."client_id" WHERE "client"."client_id" IN ( SELECT "c"."client_id" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "c"."district_id" = "d"."district_id" WHERE "c"."gender" = 'F' ORDER BY "d"."A11" ASC, "c"."birth_date" ASC LIMIT 1 )

nl_prompt: Among the accounts who have approved loan date in 1997, list out the accounts that have the lowest approved amount and choose weekly issuance statement. 'POPLATEK TYDNE' stands for weekly issuance

postgres: SELECT "T2"."account_id" FROM loan AS "T1" INNER JOIN account AS "T2" ON "T1"."account_id" = "T2"."account_id" WHERE to_char("T1"."date"::timestamp, 'YYYY') = '1997' AND "T2"."frequency" = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "T1"."amount" NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
googlesql: SELECT T2.account_id FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.date) = 1997 AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY T1.amount NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
mysql: SELECT t2.account_id FROM loan AS t1 JOIN account AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(t1.date, '%Y') = '1997' AND t2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY t1.amount LIMIT 1
